author_boundary: Reviewer authored portable DNS/HTTP validators and host fixtures, not this root/peer interface or route implementation. No backend reinvestigation or guard changes.
scope: Read-only current revision002 guest interface/route lifecycle versus exact locally pinned XNU source; not an independent runtime/SDK/artifact approval.

checked_facts.fact: connect sets UP|MULTICAST|POINTOPOINT and RUNNING; inspect() expected flags match this standard utun path.
SIOCAIFADDR assigns AF_INET local/peer/mask, with /32 mask trimmed to sin_len8 while retaining AF_INET; metadata ioctl guards allow this exact shape.
Point-to-point in_ifinit adds RTF_UP|HOST peer route with local ifa_addr as direct gateway and no host mask. Unicast peer differs from local, so in_rmx does not require LOCAL/BROADCAST flags.

Successful GET reports actual route key/gateway/mask and interface index, copies route flags then adds DONE. This matches required UP|HOST|DONE and selected direct gateway/index checks for the simple peer route.

Target compile guards92-byte base rt_msghdr and member offsets; wire parser uses bytewise little-endian fields and ROUNDUP32-style4-byte sockaddr stepping. Ordinary peer-host GET has fixed16-byte destination/gateway. Query uses protocol0 to receive failedGET family0 replies.

utun close initiates address/route cleanup and asynchronous detach. Helper does not equate close success with disappearance: bounded inventory+local/peer absence and sticky ambiguity/failure checks gate phase handoff/final cleanup.

DNS socket closes before transition; quiescent codec/host boundary precedes owned DNS interface close, complete cleanup and fresh HTTP interface creation. No raw ADD/DELETE repair or guard relaxation introduced.

unknowns: Actual target GET reply bytes/flags/gateway/index/ESRCH delivery and ioctl readbacks remain runtime observations.
Actual asynchronous teardown time and baseline inventory restoration are not established by these source/host checks.
Exclusive fresh guest management context is a caller/ancestor admission contract, not an atomic kernel route ownership lease.
No claim that absence of a bounded sampled mismatch proves all networking behavior.
actions: New diagnosis receipt only. No existing report/source edits, rebuild, tests, SSH, boot, reset, hardware or GPU action.
